card.name: Malaria prophylaxis timing and Afghan/Pakistani places
card.fires_on: Two settings: the number or space before weeks in malaria-prevention schedules (before, during and after travel), and the comma or letter just before a place name in Afghanistan or Pakistan, such as Kabul or Bhurban.

modes.label: Weeks after travel
modes.description: The number 4 or the space before it in malaria prophylaxis instructions about continuing after leaving the endemic area.

modes.description: A comma, letter or small word right before a place name in Pakistan or Afghanistan, in addresses or news text.
